newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT- Oakwood Homes rated buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT- Oakwood Homes rated buy.

text.p: Salomon Brothers said analyst Ivy Schneider started coverage of Oakwood Homes Corp with a buy rating on Wednesday.
-- shares were up 5/16 to 25-1/2 in late morning trading.
-- cited recent improvement in business fundamentals and attractive valuation.
-- "Sales should rebound after two quarters of negative comparisons," she said in a statement.
-- sees "significant increase" in same-store sales for the fiscal third quarter ended June 30, and positive results in June industry shipments.
-- sees third quarter earnings per share of $0.48 versus $0.38 last year, operating margins rising to 12.7 percent from 11.3 percent.
-- sees fiscal 1997 earnings per share of $1.75, and $2.05 in fiscal 1998.
-- company sells manufactured homes in 27 states.
